proof_body:
by
  intro G _ H _
  open Pointwise in
  letI : MulAction G (Subgroup G) := MulAction.compHom _ (MulAut.conj : G →* MulAut G)
  have hd : ∀ g : G, g • H = H.map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom := fun g => by
    ext x
    change x ∈ (MulAut.conj g) • H ↔ _
    rw [Subgroup.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
    simp [MulAut.smul_def]
  have h := MulAction.index_stabilizer G H
  have hs : MulAction.stabilizer G H = Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) := by
    ext g
    rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff, hd, Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq]
    exact Iff.rfl
  have ho : MulAction.orbit G H = {K : Subgroup G | ∃ g : G, K = H.map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom} := by
    ext K
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩; exact ⟨g, hd g⟩
    · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩; exact ⟨g, hd g⟩
  rw [hs, ho] at h
  exact h.symm
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (H : Subgroup G), {K : Subgroup G | ∃ g : G, K = H.map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom}.Finite → Set.ncard {K : Subgroup G | ∃ g : G, K = H.map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom} = (Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)).index
